display_name: LoRa W24 恢复修正的 chirp 位置与等能量消融
description: Measure the frozen W24 DURA correction by outer and inner chirps with per-packet matched edit energy.
authorization: Active LoRa and WiSig restoration research goal authorizes isolated component diagnostics.

code.commit: Pushed committed release selected at publication

data.version: Native W24 1 MHz original Full and native_residual_w24_v1
data.representation: 8 chirps, 384 complex center samples + 48 native edge samples
data.contract_ref: Archived native W24 source release, data/source contract
data.validation_ref: Same parent Full and Residual raw ordered-prediction panel

permissions.claim_scope: Actual frozen-restorer source comparison only; no oracle, further training, or target access.

checkpoint.initialization: Fixed frozen 40,000-update W24 DURA, no further fit

sources.role: Fixed source-only W24 DURA actual complete 40,000 updates

checkpoint.contract_check_ref: w24_native_residual_source frozen reader and DURA loaders; prior paired source decisions
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: Both model checkpoints are validated frozen source-only artifacts with exact data contract.
checkpoint.selection_rule: All masks and blend profiles fixed before source scores. No validation-based tuning within this run.

execution.gpu_policy: One qualified GPU, prefer 6 or 3; eight CPU channel workers
execution.stop_rule: Stop downstream on provenance, energy control, blind replay, nonfinite values, source order or full frozen prediction failures.

rows.method: Real all-packet W24 DURA with fixed position masks or matched energy weights
rows.seed_notes: Existing source split and source RF seeds reused without draws from any other panel. No candidate fit or support.
rows.budget_ref: 300 registered source V packets per route; 7 paired scenes; 6 readouts; 1 restoration forward per packet

notes: Source-only inference with no true noise or simulated parameters entering the recovery input.
Each packet is restored once; fixed input-coordinate masks affect only the independent diagnostic readouts.
Preferred weights are 1.25 and 0.75, then renormalized to the all-half update energy per packet.
